title: Indian Market News Brief — 28 Oct 2026 — Nifty 50
quick_read: Strong profit growth at major companies like L&T and Bajaj Auto may support the market. However, crude oil prices crossing 120 dollars per barrel and lower earnings from Maruti Suzuki and Mazagon Dock could create pressure. Proposed regulatory changes for options trading and weather concerns add further uncertainty.

stories.headline: India’s crude basket price tops $120 a barrel amid West Asia war
stories.summary: India's crude oil purchase price has crossed 120 dollars per barrel due to the ongoing West Asia war. Shipping insurance costs and transport fees have also increased. Higher crude prices make fuel and raw materials more expensive across the country.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: High oil prices can raise inflation and increase operating costs for many Indian companies.

stories.headline: Larsen & Toubro Q2 Results: Profit surges 33% YoY to Rs 5,202 crore, revenue grows 16%
stories.summary: Larsen and Toubro reported a 33 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to 5,202 crore rupees for the second quarter. Total revenue grew by 16 percent during the same period. The company showed healthy business growth across its infrastructure operations.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Strong results from a major infrastructure company can boost overall market confidence.

stories.headline: Bajaj Auto Q2 Results: Profit jumps 35% YoY to Rs 3,354 crore; revenue up 34%
stories.summary: Bajaj Auto posted a 35 percent jump in net profit to 3,354 crore rupees for the July to September quarter. Quarterly revenue rose 34 percent to 20,003 crore rupees, crossing this milestone for the first time. Operating profit grew over 37 percent.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Good profit and sales growth signal strong demand in the two-wheeler auto sector.

stories.headline: Maruti Suzuki Q2 Results: Profit falls 26% YoY to Rs 2,466 crore, but revenue rises 26%
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki reported a 26 percent fall in second-quarter net profit to 2,466 crore rupees. However, quarterly revenue grew by 26 percent to 53,356 crore rupees. Higher material costs and employee expenses increased total operating expenses.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Lower profit margins at the country's top carmaker may weigh on auto sector sentiment.

stories.headline: Indian lenders defer dollar debt sale plan as rates turn expensive
stories.summary: Several Indian banks including Canara Bank and Punjab National Bank are delaying plans to sell dollar debt abroad. Rising US borrowing costs and a weaker rupee have made foreign loans expensive. A currency protection facility from the Reserve Bank of India is also ending in December.

stories.headline: Defence stocks rally: Apollo Micro Systems, Data Patterns, BEML, HAL, BEL surge as DAC clears acquisition push, Aequs & Mazagon Dock slump after Q2
stories.summary: Defence company shares rose after the Defence Acquisition Council cleared new purchase proposals. Shares of Apollo Micro Systems and Data Patterns climbed over 9 percent. Key state-run suppliers including Hindustan Aeronautics and Bharat Electronics also gained.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Fresh government spending approvals provide clear business visibility for defence manufacturers.

stories.headline: Derivatives trading may need more guardrails, says Sebi's KVR Murty
stories.summary: Market regulator SEBI is reviewing whether additional safety rules are needed for trading in futures and options. An official noted that extra checks are being discussed for days when trading contracts expire. This comes during a period of high trading activity by small investors.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Stricter trading rules may lower trading volumes across stock brokerages.

stories.headline: El Nino ramping up into a ‘very strong' weather event as index surges to 18-year high
stories.summary: The Australian weather agency reported that the El Nino weather system is strengthening rapidly. The ocean temperature measure reached its highest level since 2008 in late October. A positive weather event in the Indian Ocean is also active at the same time.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Weak monsoon patterns could lower farm output and push up food prices.

stories.headline: SAIL Q2 Results: Net profit surges four-fold to Rs 1750 crore on higher revenue
stories.summary: Steel Authority of India reported a four-fold increase in second-quarter net profit to 1,750 crore rupees. Revenue from operations grew to 31,997 crore rupees compared to 26,704 crore rupees in the previous year. Total expenses also increased to 29,913 crore rupees.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Higher profit from a large steelmaker suggests steady demand for industrial metals.

stories.headline: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders shares crash 10% after Q2 net profit tumbles 54%; firm declares Rs 5/share dividend
stories.summary: Shares of Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders fell 10 percent following a 54 percent drop in second-quarter profit to 344 crore rupees. Revenue fell 16.5 percent to 2,446 crore rupees due to lower operational margins. The company declared an interim dividend of 5 rupees per share.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Sharp profit declines in public sector shipbuilders can hurt investor confidence in defence stocks.
